info.title: JARVIS GitHub dispatch (approval-gated)
info.description: Copilot Studio REST API import candidate. GitHub repository_dispatch is blocked by the existing JARVIS workflow gate until separately approved. Importing this file does not grant access, install a tool, or authorize autonomous execution.

GitHubAuthorization.name: Authorization
GitHubAuthorization.description: Use a secure Power Platform connection. Enter the complete header value 'Bearer <token>' only in the protected connection setup, never in a prompt, this file or source control. Restrict GitHub access to this repository with Contents: write.

post.summary: Dispatch JARVIS task only after explicit human approval
post.description: Never invoke automatically. Require explicit human confirmation for every task and separate safety approval before any deployment. HTTP 204 acknowledges receipt only and does not prove execution. Keep JARVIS_REPOSITORY_DISPATCH_ENABLED disabled until reviewed.

parameters.name: dispatch
parameters.description: Non-sensitive explicitly approved task. Never include credentials or private information.

event_type.description: Must match the existing workflow's repository_dispatch trigger.

task.description: Explicitly approved task, without secrets or sensitive personal data.

tier.description: Choose FREE for first approved smoke test. FREE does not guarantee zero external cost.

request_id.description: Optional UUID for tracing. Do not include end-user identifiers.

204.description: GitHub accepted the dispatch request; does not prove that JARVIS ran.

403.description: Insufficient repository permissions or policy restriction.

404.description: Repository not accessible to the authenticated account.
